title: Catalog search offers Try again only when a retry can help
acceptance: A 429 PROVIDER_QUOTA_EXCEEDED in catalog search (TrackSearch search mode and the Music tab search in Dashboard.tsx) shows its sentence with no Try again; network, timeout and 5xx failures keep Try again.
The Music tab search shows the API sentence for quota and the Spotify allowlist instead of the generic "Couldn’t search … right now. Try again."

evidence.summary: Music tab search .catch() drops the error and always sets the generic retry sentence; the Try again button shows whenever results are null. Read on fix/rf-74-playlist-retry, 2026-11-13.

Added on the RF-219 branch and passing in the builder session, 2026-11-26: "offers no Try again when the catalog search hits a spent quota (RF-219)" and "keeps Try again on the catalog search for …" (network failure, provider timeout 504, provider 502, server 500). Mocked api.searchProvider; no real provider.

Added on the RF-219 branch and passing in the builder session, 2026-11-26: Music catalog search "shows the quota sentence with no Try again", "shows the Spotify allowlist sentence and keeps Try again", and "keeps the generic sentence and Try again" for a provider timeout, a provider 5xx and a server error; the existing network-outage retry test still passes. Mocked api.searchProvider; no real provider.
PR for RF-219 in batch #805, opened as a draft by the builder on 2026-11-26 after the conductor reported stages 3–5 passed on a1c1d29fc5fee92202aaafb08e1cd00f0adbb107; not merged.

resolution: Built in batch #805 on branch fix/rf-219-search-retry-only-when-useful. In TrackSearch search mode a 429 PROVIDER_QUOTA_EXCEEDED keeps its API sentence (now in the caution colour) and no longer renders Try again; every other search failure keeps the generic sentence and Try again. The Music tab search in Dashboard.tsx now reads the error: quota and the Spotify allowlist (SPOTIFY_DEVELOPMENT_MODE) show the API sentence, quota with no Try again, the allowlist with Try again (its sentence ends "then retry", the same call RF-74 made for playlists); network, timeout and 5xx failures keep the generic sentence and Try again. Not done, and not in the acceptance: TrackSearch search mode still shows the generic sentence for the allowlist. No API, contract, schema or provider-code change; CI cannot show a real provider 429.
